description: Per-field options for a match_phrase clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed match_phrase map (the map key is the column name).

query.description: Required. The phrase to match. A string (or scalar value on a non-text column).

analyzer.description: Optional. Analyzer used to tokenize the phrase. Defaults to the field's search analyzer.

slop.description: Optional. Number of positions allowed between matching terms. Default 0 (exact phrase).

zero_terms_query.description: Optional. Behavior when the analyzer removes all tokens: none (default) or all.

boost.description: Optional. Multiplier for the relevance score of this clause. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.
